name: Caffe Trieste
notes: CASH-LEANING. Oldest espresso bar on the West Coast (1956). Weekend cappuccino spot, culturally analog — not an office. Open late (~10pm).

name: Caffè Greco
notes: CASH ONLY (verified in person). Open until ~11pm — the evening decaf-latte spot once you carry cash. Joe-app mobile ordering listing is stale.

name: Golden Boy Pizza
notes: Legendary focaccia squares. A treat, not a system — log it for intentional nights.

name: Cavalli Cafe
notes: Danny's find: two floors, 2nd floor good for relaxed work; open late (Mon 10pm, Tue-Sun ~11pm) — solves the everything-closes-at-4 problem. Decaf lattes. Food is comfort Italian (panini, cannoli); tuna sandwich = most protein-forward.

name: Luke's Local Grocery
notes: 2 min from home, 8am-9pm. Quality tier but pricey (deli plates ~$16, $11 tiny burrito — Danny verified) — role: emergency ingredients + prepared dinner when the TJ's window is missed, NOT staples or everyday lunch. Real butcher counter.

name: Molinari Delicatessen
notes: 100-year-old deli next door to 371 Columbus. Giant ~$15 sandwiches — the 'not cooking tonight' move. Closes late afternoon; closed Sundays.

name: Tony's Coal Fired Pizza & Slice House
Compton's Coffe House
notes: Backup office: free fast wifi, outlet bar under counter, ~6 solo tables; tight at peak, go early. Apple Pay unverified.

name: Réveille Coffee Co.
notes: Default morning office; closes 4pm. Healthy picks: Tahini Squash Bowl (lunch, 11:15+), Breakfast Bowl (all day). Skip: burrito (tater tots), acai/granola (sugar). Add-on math: +1 egg $2.50 ok, avocado add-on redundant.

name: Stockton St produce stalls
notes: Cheapest produce in SF; several stalls, treat as one corridor. Mostly cash — bring small bills. Google Translate camera mode for labels.

name: Duk Hing Chinese Deli & Meat Inc.
Little Window by Bicycle Banh Mi
Vital Tea-Leaf
notes: Free try-before-you-buy tasting bar, ~300 teas (ask for Uncle Gee). Buy loose-leaf green (~$0.30/cup at home) — the budget green-tea habit.

name: Metro Milk Tea Hong Kong Dessert
Paper Son at Soon and Soon
Wok Shop
notes: Buy the 6-qt stockpot here (sous vide bath + soup pot). Cheap restaurant-grade kitchenware.

name: Grocery Outlet
notes: Opened Aug 2026 in the old Safeway space, across from Trader Joe's. Deep-discount pantry staples; stock rotates. Not yet in OSM.

name: Fiddle Fig Cafe
notes: Roomy, plant-filled, laptop-normal. Wifi password 'coffeeandplants', outlets, sunny corner + sidewalk seats. Good breakfast burrito. Not yet in OSM.

name: Trader Joe's
notes: Staples HQ, open to 9pm; has a parking lot. The zero-cook kit: Just Grilled Chicken Strips + salad kit + avocado (~$8 dinner); steamed lentils; tofu spring rolls (fresh, not fried — appetizer not meal); pre-peeled boiled eggs; Greek yogurt; frozen backup meals as the delivery-app circuit breaker.

name: Fisherman’s Wharf Chowder and Crab Sidewalk Stands
